items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had interesting discussions... we ended up parting on not-good terms... He’s a way great musician... Tapes I have of him in ’69 with LaRoca... I really learned through him about strings.

ctx.x: Because he came to New York when he was about 20.

That’s what I mean. He just learned. He’s a quick study. So you could talk. He was the kind of guy that could go on and on. He’s a little bit of a loop, a little like LaRoca. It’s a little like, “Yeah but,” and then circuitous reasoning, no conclusion. So you can pick it up tomorrow night. This is good and bad, frustrating. We had interesting discussions. Of course, in the end, we ended up parting on not-good terms, basically because I smoked a joint the last gig and had a relationship with the viola player.…
How long did that last with Chick?
